reviews.comment:
Dr. Harris does some research but his research/mentoring quality simply does not match the TAMU standard when compared to other stat. profs, if I can be honest...
I agree with the other comment about why he left too.

Dr. Harris was an excellent professor. Super kind, fun, and easy going with fun projects and lecture material. Understanding guy and very well esteemed in his research. I'd recommend taking his course! The BEST prof in the stat department.
I am not sure about the rest reviews, I personally feel that the course is not very useful. Dr. Harris also put more weight on research instead of teaching, a reason why he left.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cool guy! You need to know Python by now so don't expect to learn the basics here or you'll be lost. You learn super useful coding skills for industry/research in PyTorch/Sci-Kit Learn for modeling/neural networks through COLAB lectures, COLAB HW, and Canvas exams that test theory from lectures (he does review days so it's easy to do well).

Best stat professor! Very understanding and relaxed. Lectures are clear and homeworks reflect lecture material. Exams are take home and are similar in difficulty to homeworks. There are no surprises or catches. Everything is straightforward. Attendance is optional and he thinks in the shoes of his students.
